suppress.notes: False positive: CVE-2026-33117 affects com.azure:azure-security-keyvault-keys versions before 4.10.6. This project does not include azure-security-keyvault-keys; the reported Azure Service Bus runtime artifacts (azure-core, azure-core-amqp, azure-core-http-netty, and azure-json) do not contain the affected Key Vault Keys local cryptographic verification code. Dependency-Check 12.2.2 reports them because NVD associates the CVE with the broad azure_sdk_for_java CPE. Microsoft identifies the affected component as the Key Vault Keys library; see https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-97jf-46m3-8953 and https://github.com/dependency-check/DependencyCheck/issues/8553.
The application does not enable or expose the writable /actuator/env endpoint, so the vulnerable functionality is not reachable.
Spring Data JPA is present, but the application does not accept untrusted Sort/Pageable values for native SQL queries.
